title: One row of data/effects.jsonl
description: The average effect of one intervention on one marker in a meta-analysis or randomized trial, copied from the source with a short verbatim quote. Used only to say whether a person's observed change is in line with what trials saw on average. Never a personal prediction and never a dose instruction.

keywords.description: Words that name this intervention in a person's plan (地中海饮食, Mediterranean).

marker_key.description: Key in data/biological_variation.json, when the marker has one.

kind.description: mean_difference and percent_change compare directly with a person's change in the same unit; per_unit is per one unit of exposure (per); standardized (Cohen's d) and rate (per year) are not directly comparable.

per.description: For per_unit: what one unit of the intervention is (1 kg weight lost).

verified.description: true once the numbers were checked against the source; see verified_by for how.

verified_by.description: Who checked the numbers: a person against the paper, or a script that matched the verbatim quote against the source text and checked every number of the effect appears in it. Required when verified is true. Only a human reviewer sets person (with verified_by_name and verified_on); automated agents always write quote_match.

marker_terms.description: Words the quote uses for the marker when they differ from marker, marker_zh and the biological-variation aliases (e.g. "HbA1c" written as "glycated haemoglobin").

verified_on.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) a person checked the row against the paper. Required with verified_by: person.

verified_by_name.description: Name of the person who checked the row against the paper. Required with verified_by: person, absent otherwise.

tau_pct.description: Between-person standard deviation of the true response, in % of baseline, as reported (or computed from what is reported) in tau_source. Absent when no source reports it; the response predictor then uses its documented default (|average effect|) and says so.

quote.description: Continuous verbatim span that reports the between-person variability.

note.description: How tau_pct was obtained from the quoted numbers, when it is not printed as such.

tau_source.description: Source of tau_pct; required when tau_pct is set.
